name: multi-agent-desktop-python
author: Multi-agent Team
description: Electron + React + FastAPI desktop AI agent workspace

scripts.dev: pnpm dev:clean && pnpm models:sync && concurrently -k -n VITE,PYTHON,MODELS,ELECTRON -c auto "pnpm frontend:dev" "pnpm backend:dev" "pnpm models:watch" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173/ http-get://127.0.0.1:3100/api/health && pnpm electron:watch"
scripts.backend:dev: cross-env PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 BACKEND_RELOAD=1 MULTI_AGENT_DESKTOP_DEV=1 BACKEND_HOST=127.0.0.1 BACKEND_PORT=3100 python -m backend.main --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3100 --reload --reload-dir backend
scripts.backend:check: python -m compileall -q backend scripts/build-python-backend.py scripts/embed_builtin_credentials.py scripts/sync_model_catalog.py scripts/show_model_routes.py scripts/clean_dev_runtime.py
scripts.verify: pnpm models:sync && pnpm quality && pnpm planning:test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm electron:typecheck && pnpm backend:check && pnpm backend:test && pnpm build
scripts.electron:pack: pnpm release:clean && pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm electron:prepare-icons && pnpm exec electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:make: pnpm release:clean && pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm electron:prepare-icons && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:make:win: pnpm release:clean && pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm electron:prepare-icons && pnpm exec electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:make:mac: pnpm release:clean && pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm electron:prepare-icons && pnpm exec electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:make:linux: pnpm release:clean && pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm electron:prepare-icons && pnpm exec electron-builder --linux --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:watch: cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 BACKEND_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 ELECTRON_DEV_STRICT=1 tsx scripts/dev-electron.ts
scripts.lint: eslint app electron scripts main.tsx vite.config.ts
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm python:lint && pnpm python:format:check && pnpm source:check
